name: CRM Engagement
description: The engagement layer for the CRM core: relationship notes, lightweight tasks/reminders, important dates, and a manual interaction log (calls, meetings, messages), all linked to crm_contacts by UUID with ON DELETE CASCADE. On top of those tables it derives a per-contact relationship-health summary (overdue tasks, due-soon tasks, upcoming dates, gone-quiet detection) and a keep-in-touch suggestion queue with dismiss/snooze/convert-to-task review history. The suggestion engine reads only this engagement data plus crm_contacts — no Gmail pipeline, no entity graph, no projection cache. UUID id contract throughout: every PK is UUID, contact_id is UUID REFERENCES public.crm_contacts(id), and crm_interactions.thought_id is UUID REFERENCES public.thoughts(id). RLS on every table, all privileges revoked from PUBLIC/anon/authenticated and granted only to service_role, every function SECURITY INVOKER. Note bodies and interaction summaries are kept out of the audit log. Requires the crm-core schema (apply it first).
